definition.en: A rocket that lifts and accelerates a spacecraft.
definition.zh: 把飞船升空并加速的火箭。

definition.en: A rocket section with propulsion that can separate from the rest of the vehicle.
definition.zh: 带有推进装置、能与其余飞行器分离的火箭段。

definition.en: The force on a rocket as it expels material.
definition.zh: 火箭排出物质时受到的力。

definition.en: Material an engine carries and expels to produce thrust. Here it includes fuel and oxidiser.
definition.zh: 发动机携带并排出、用来产生推力的物质。这里包括燃料和氧化剂。

definition.en: A substance that reacts with an oxidiser and releases energy.
definition.zh: 与氧化剂反应并释放能量的物质。

definition.en: A substance that supports the fuel’s reaction. A rocket carries its own supply.
definition.zh: 支持燃料反应的物质。火箭自己携带氧化剂。

definition.en: A shaped outlet that guides hot gas as it expands out of an engine.
definition.zh: 引导发动机热气膨胀排出的特定形状出口。

definition.en: The part of the launch vehicle that guides and controls its flight.
definition.zh: 负责运载火箭制导和飞行控制的部分。

definition.en: An orbit around Earth used before departure towards the Moon.
definition.zh: 出发去月球前，飞船先进入的地球轨道。

definition.en: An acceleration that sends a spacecraft onto a path towards the Moon.
definition.zh: 让飞船加速、进入通向月球轨迹的过程。

definition.en: The Apollo crew cabin that returns through Earth’s atmosphere.
definition.zh: 搭载阿波罗乘员、穿过地球大气层返回的舱体。

definition.en: The Apollo section that supplies propulsion and support, then separates before atmospheric entry.
definition.zh: 提供阿波罗推进和支持、在进入大气层前分离的舱段。

definition.en: The separate Apollo craft whose descent and ascent stages carry the crew between lunar orbit and the surface.
definition.zh: 独立的阿波罗飞行器，靠下降级和上升级搭载乘员往返月球轨道与月面。

definition.en: A protective surface that limits cabin heating during atmospheric entry.
definition.zh: 进入大气层时，减少乘员舱受热的保护表面。

definition.en: A calculated change in velocity using exhaust speed and the ratio of starting to final mass. It assumes ideal conditions rather than a measured flight.
definition.zh: 用排气速度与初始、最终质量的比值算出的速度改变量，采用理想条件，不是实测飞行速度。
